```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Use the locally bundled libraries instead of Observable's CDN defaults
Inputs = window.Inputs
Plot = window.Plot
html = window.htl.html
// Label that switches with the language button (CSS shows one span)
L = (en, zh) => html`<span class="en">${en}</span><span class="zh">${zh}</span>`
// Current language, updated when the button is pressed (for chart text)
lang = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-lang") || "en");
  f();
  const mo = new MutationObserver(f);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"]});
  return () => mo.disconnect();
})
T = (en, zh) => lang === "zh" ? zh : en
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof capacity = Inputs.range([150000, 800000], {value: 450000, step: 10000, label: L("Capacity (t/yr)", "处理量（吨/年）")})
viewof capexPerT = Inputs.range([1000, 2600], {value: 1850, step: 50, label: L("Capex per t/yr (A$)", "单位投资（澳元）")})
viewof gateFee = Inputs.range([80, 250], {value: 150, step: 5, label: L("Gate fee (A$/t)", "处理费（澳元/吨）")})
viewof powerKwh = Inputs.range([400, 800], {value: 600, step: 10, label: L("Power exported (kWh/t)", "上网电量（千瓦时/吨）")})
viewof powerPrice = Inputs.range([30, 120], {value: 70, step: 5, label: L("Power price (A$/MWh)", "电价（澳元/兆瓦时）")})
viewof opexPerT = Inputs.range([30, 120], {value: 70, step: 5, label: L("Opex (A$/t)", "运营成本（澳元/吨）")})
viewof availability = Inputs.range([0.7, 0.95], {value: 0.9, step: 0.01, label: L("Availability", "可用率")})
viewof inflation = Inputs.range([0, 0.06], {value: 0.025, step: 0.005, label: L("Inflation", "通胀率")})
viewof discount = Inputs.range([0.03, 0.12], {value: 0.07, step: 0.005, label: L("Discount rate", "折现率")})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
years = 25
capex = capacity * capexPerT
rows = {
  let cum = -capex, out = [{year: 0, cash: -capex, cumulative: cum}];
  for (let y = 1; y <= years; y++) {
    const t = capacity * availability, g = Math.pow(1 + inflation, y - 1);
    const rev = t * gateFee * g + t * powerKwh / 1000 * powerPrice * g;
    const cash = rev - t * opexPerT * g;
    cum += cash;
    out.push({year: y, cash, cumulative: cum});
  }
  return out;
}
payback = rows.find(r => r.year > 0 && r.cumulative >= 0)?.year
npv = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.cash / Math.pow(1 + discount, r.year), 0)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><b>${T("Capex", "投资")}:</b> A$${(capex/1e6).toFixed(0)}m · <b>${T("Payback", "回收期")}:</b> ${payback ? payback + T(" years", " 年") : T("not within 25 years", "25年内未回本")} · <b>${T("NPV", "净现值")}:</b> A$${(npv/1e6).toFixed(0)}m</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  height: 320, marginLeft: 60,
  y: {label: T("Cumulative cash (A$m)", "累计现金流（百万澳元）"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
  x: {label: T("Year", "年")},
  marks: [Plot.ruleY([0]), Plot.areaY(rows, {x: "year", y: "cumulative", fillOpacity: 0.15}), Plot.lineY(rows, {x: "year", y: "cumulative"})]
})
```
